Preserved free-disk gate **≥ ceil(1.5 × eligible source file bytes + 3 GiB)** before copy and **≥ 3 GiB** after; source `pnpm store path` must be rooted **v10**, and pnpm's effective `--store-dir <disposable-base> store path --silent` must equal the actual new `<disposable-base>/v10`, **before** any possible Install.
